title: Captain Hayle
description: In the more peaceful era of the New Republic, Captain Hayle, a grizzled veteran of the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Civil War, commanded the Vesper. Hayle was willing to face enemy threats head-on, like confronting rogue mercenaries Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati, who claimed to be Jedi, even if that meant his own death.
